why_ai: Screen-based design work that generative tools increasingly produce directly.
why_clarity: Design arguments are settled by seniority because outcomes never return.
why_digital: Figma files in, designs and systems out, sold to remote clients.

why_ai: Building a structured evidence corpus is analysis work AI tooling handles well.
why_clarity: Comparable measurements are possible, but results arrive slowly and confounded.
why_digital: Engagement records and analytics combined into a digital corpus.

why_ai: States, variants, specs and assets are repetitive production AI automates.
why_clarity: Specs and assets are defined deliverables repeated every engagement.
why_digital: Design files in, specs and assets out for developers.

why_ai: Drift detection between design files and code is a software sync problem.
why_clarity: Component drift between library and production code is measurable.
why_digital: Component libraries and code compared and synced in software.

why_ai: Pricing uncertain discovery is a commercial judgment estimable from project history.
why_clarity: Scope depends on unknown findings, so estimates vary by person.
why_digital: Project history in, proposals and prices out remotely.

why_ai: Proving design caused outcomes needs client access and credible measurement.
why_clarity: Evidence lands in client analytics after contracts close, if ever.
why_digital: Client analytics in, outcome evidence out.

why_ai: Capture, assembly and approval chasing are mechanical and automatable.
why_clarity: Case studies follow a template, though persuasiveness is subjective.
why_digital: Project files in, case studies out online.

why_ai: Negotiating analytics access and baselines depends on the client relationship.
why_clarity: Metric is agreed at kickoff, but confounded results arrive months later.
why_digital: Analytics data compared remotely per engagement.

why_ai: Getting stakeholders to agree is relationship and persuasion work.
why_clarity: Objections are preferences with no evidence to settle them.
why_digital: Design reviews held in meetings and online tools.

why_ai: Defending decisions rests on persuasion, though evidence retrieval automates.
why_clarity: The same argument recurs with no objective arbiter.
why_digital: Design rationale and evidence surfaced in screens and meetings.

why_ai: Burn tracking and scope detection automate; raising it remains relationship work.
why_clarity: Budget burn against plan is measurable on every engagement.
why_digital: Timesheets and budgets tracked in spreadsheets and tools.
